# University of Toledo

> The University of Toledo is a comprehensive public research institution offering undergraduate, graduate, and online degree programs across eight colleges with emphasis on engineering, health sciences, business, and law.

UToledo serves students from Ohio and internationally through multiple admission pathways including traditional undergraduate, graduate, transfer, adult learner, and dual-credit programs. The university operates through specialized colleges including Engineering, Medicine and Life Sciences, Law, Business and Innovation, Health and Human Services, Arts and Social Sciences, and an Honors College.

## Admission & Application

- [Apply to The University of Toledo](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/apply): Application portal for undergraduate and graduate programs
- [Undergraduate Admission](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/undergraduate): Undergraduate admission requirements and process at UToledo
- [Graduate Admission](https://www.utoledo.edu/graduate): Graduate program admission and degree options at UToledo
- [Adult and Transfer Admission](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/transfer-adult-student): Transfer and adult student admission pathways at UToledo
- [University of Toledo Undergraduate International Admission](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/international): International student admission requirements and visa information
- [Campus Visits](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/visit): Schedule campus visits and virtual tours at UToledo
- [New Rocket Next Steps](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/admitted-rocket): Post-admission steps for new UToledo students

## Academic Programs & Colleges

- [Find Your Major Or Program](https://www.utoledo.edu/programs): Browse undergraduate and graduate degree programs by college
- [College of Engineering](https://www.utoledo.edu/engineering): Engineering programs with required co-ops and research opportunities
- [College of Medicine and Life Sciences](https://www.utoledo.edu/med): Medical and life sciences degrees with graduate programs
- [College of Health and Human Services](https://www.utoledo.edu/hhs): Health sciences and human services degree programs
- [College of Law](https://www.utoledo.edu/law): Law school JD programs and clinical legal education
- [College of Business and Innovation](https://www.utoledo.edu/business): Business and Innovation college degrees and accreditation info
- [Judith Herb College of Arts, Social Sciences and Education](https://www.utoledo.edu/jhc): Arts, Social Sciences and Education college programs and overview
- [Honors College](https://www.utoledo.edu/honors): Jesup Scott Honors College programs and student opportunities

## Online & Alternative Learning

- [UToledo Online Programs](https://online.utoledo.edu): Online degree programs and certificates at UToledo
- [College Credit Plus (CCP)](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/college-credit-plus): Dual-credit program for Ohio high school students grades 7-12

- [Guest Student](https://www.utoledo.edu/admission/guests.html): Non-degree enrollment and guest student application process
